<?php

function solve_cf762B() {
    $input = fopen("php://stdin", "r");
    if (file_exists("input.txt")) {
        $input = fopen("input.txt", "r");
    }

    $t = (int)trim(fgets($input));
    $output = [];

    while ($t-- > 0) {
        $n = (int)trim(fgets($input));
        $used = [];

        for ($i = 1; $i * $i <= $n; $i++) {
            $val = $i * $i;
            $used[$val] = $val;
        }
        for ($i = 1; $i * $i * $i <= $n; $i++) {
            $val = $i * $i * $i;
            $used[$val] = $val;
        }
        $output[] = count($used);
    }

    fclose($input);
    echo implode("\n", $output) . "\n";
}

function solve_cf762A() {
    $input = fopen("php://stdin", "r");
    if (file_exists("input.txt")) {
        $input = fopen("input.txt", "r");
    }

    $t = (int)trim(fgets($input));
    $output = [];

    while ($t-- > 0) {
        $s = trim(fgets($input));
        $n = strlen($s);
        if ($n % 2 != 0) {
            $output[] = "NO";
        } else {
            $ok = true;
            $half = $n / 2;
            for ($i = 0; $i < $half; $i++) {
                if ($s[$i] !== $s[$half + $i]) {
                    $ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            $output[] = $ok ? "YES" : "NO";
        }
    }

    fclose($input);
    echo implode("\n", $output) . "\n";
}

solve_cf762B();
